stageFirst.eli5: It is the first step of the {stage}.
stageFirst.simple: It is the first block of the {stage}.

stageLast.eli5: It is the last step of the {stage}.
stageLast.simple: It is the last block of the {stage}; what it makes goes on to {next}.

firstAtLevel.eli5: It is the first step that works on the {size}×{size} picture, which is good for {objects} things.
firstAtLevel.simple: It is the first block that sees {level} features: a {size}×{size} map with {channels} channels. Each cell here covers about {stride}×{stride} pixels of the image.
firstAtLevel.engineer: First layer at stride {stride} ({level}), {channels} channels, {size}×{size} grid.

halves.eli5: It makes the picture half as wide and half as tall ({inSize} → {outSize}).
halves.simple: It halves the width and height ({inSize} → {outSize}), so each cell now summarises a bigger area of the image.

doubles.eli5: It makes the picture twice as big ({inSize} → {outSize}).
doubles.simple: It doubles the width and height ({inSize} → {outSize}) so the map can be joined with a larger one.

keepsSize.eli5: The picture stays the same size.
keepsSize.simple: The map keeps its size ({outSize}); this block only changes what the channels describe.

channelsUp.eli5: It writes more kinds of notes: {inC} → {outC}.
channelsUp.simple: It increases the channels from {inC} to {outC}, giving room for more kinds of patterns.

channelsDown.simple: It reduces the channels from {inC} to {outC}, keeping the most useful information and saving compute later.

joins.eli5: It stacks together the notes from {sources}.

feedsHead.eli5: The head uses this picture to find {objects} things.
feedsHead.simple: This {level} map goes straight to the head, which uses it to find {objects} objects.

reused.eli5: Its notes are kept and used again later by {targets}.
reused.simple: Its output is also saved and reused later by {targets} (a skip link), so later layers can get back its detail.

repeats.eli5: Inside, a small helper is repeated {n} times in this model size.
repeats.simple: In this model size the inner unit is repeated {n} times (the YAML says {yamlN}, times the depth multiple {depth}).

share.eli5: It holds {pct} of all the model's learned numbers.
share.simple: It holds {params} parameters ({pct} of the model) and needs {flops} GFLOPs.

consumerVerbs.Detect: turns it into box and class predictions
consumerVerbs.v10Detect: turns it into box and class predictions
consumerVerbs.Segment: turns it into boxes, classes and masks
consumerVerbs.Pose: turns it into boxes and keypoints
consumerVerbs.Classify: turns it into one class for the whole image
